# VAULTX

> VAULTX is a concept streetwear store from Prague: black hoodies, knitwear, leather outerwear, tees, headwear and belts, shown in black and white. It is a portfolio project; no real orders or payments are processed.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://denysovski.github.io/VaultX/): Drop 07 Curfew, the brand story and delivery promises
- [Shop](https://denysovski.github.io/VaultX/shop/): all products with filters for category, size, price and stock
- [Breach Leather Jacket](https://denysovski.github.io/VaultX/shop/breach-leather-jacket/): washed lambskin, hooded
- [About us](https://denysovski.github.io/VaultX/about/): the studio, and pages for creators, artists and designers
- [Help desk](https://denysovski.github.io/VaultX/help/): order tracking, delivery problems, returns, FAQ and contact
- [Terms](https://denysovski.github.io/VaultX/terms/) and [Privacy](https://denysovski.github.io/VaultX/privacy/)
